name: funkfmpeg
description: Indexed PNG spritesheets/tapes and video frame extraction (FFmpeg libav, statically linked; Windows/Linux/Android 64) for Haxe/Lime.
releasenote: 1.4.13: API de video solo enteros/const char* (probe y start) para Android; FFmpeg compilado con --enable-everything. 1.4.12: probe de video tolera find_stream_info parcial y propaga el error nativo real. 1.4.11: Android compilado con -mno-outline-atomics (arregla dlopen failed: cannot locate symbol __aarch64_ldadd8_acq_rel). 1.4.0: VideoFrames now uses FFmpeg (static LGPL build) on Windows, Linux and Android arm64 instead of minimp4+h264bsd / MediaMetadataRetriever.
